2608.16637.title: PDDLCoder: Agentic PDDL Generation for LLM-Assisted Symbolic Planning
2608.16637.paper_summary: LLMs remain unreliable for long-horizon planning, often generating logically inconsistent or non-applicable plans. Recent hybrid methods instead translate natural language into the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), allowing symbolic planners to produce verifiable plans. However, existing methods frequently rely on rigid generation pipelines, a partial PDDL definition, or human feedback. Furthermore, their evaluation is hindered by the lack of standardized benchmarks with automated verification. To address these limitations, we present PDDLCoder, an agentic framework for PDDL generation from natural language that iteratively generates, analyzes, and refines planning specifications. We further introduce NL-pddlgym, a benchmark dataset comprising 711 planning problems across 23 domains with executable gym environments for the automated verification of plan applicability. Experiments on the NL-pddlgym test set containing 106 problems across 4 held-out domains show that PDDLCoder generates applicable plans for 89.6\% of tested planning problems. This improves upon our adaptations of previous PDDL generation methods, which achieved up to 45.3\%, and outperforms direct LLM planning approaches, which reached up to 74.5\% on the same test set. Our work demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic PDDL generation for planning and establishes a reproducible benchmark for future research on LLM-assisted symbolic planning.
2608.16637.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 在長期規劃方面仍然不可靠，經常生成邏輯上不一致或不適用的計劃。最近的混合方法則將自然語言轉換為規劃領域定義語言 (PDDL)，使符號規劃者能夠生成可驗證的計劃。然而，現有方法經常依賴僵化的生成管道、部分的 PDDL 定義或人類反饋。此外，它們的評估受到缺乏標準化基準和自動驗證的阻礙。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了 PDDLCoder，一個從自然語言生成 PDDL 的代理框架，該框架迭代生成、分析和完善規劃規範。我們進一步介紹了 NL-pddlgym，一個基準數據集，包含 711 個規劃問題，涵蓋 23 個領域，並配備可執行的 gym 環境以自動驗證計劃的適用性。在包含 106 個問題的 NL-pddlgym 測試集上的實驗顯示，PDDLCoder 為 89.6\% 的測試規劃問題生成了適用的計劃。這比我們對先前 PDDL 生成方法的改編有所改善，後者的成功率達到 45.3\%，並且超越了直接的 LLM 規劃方法，後者在相同測試集上的成功率達到 74.5\%。我們的工作展示了代理 PDDL 生成在規劃中的有效性，並為未來在 LLM 輔助的符號規劃研究中建立了一個可重複的基準。
